title: Commerce, Law & Management — full admission tables
description: The calculator only checks a sample of Wits programmes. This viewer opens the official 2027 Wits undergraduate prospectus near the Commerce / Law & Management section. If the section is slightly off, use the PDF page thumbnails or search in your browser’s PDF toolbar.

title: Engineering & the Built Environment — full admission tables
description: Opens the same official prospectus near the Engineering and Built Environment admissions pages. Page numbers can change when the PDF is updated—use the viewer’s sidebar if needed.

title: Health Sciences — full admission tables
description: Opens the prospectus near the Health Sciences faculty requirements (including NBT notes). Always confirm closing dates and selection rules on the official site.

title: Humanities — full admission tables
description: Opens the prospectus near the Humanities faculty section (BA, BEd, professional degrees, etc.).

title: Science (Natural / Mathematical / Biological) — full admission tables
description: Opens the prospectus near the Faculty of Science undergraduate requirements (BSc streams, NBT note, etc.). This is the “natural sciences” style block in the Wits PDF.

title: UWC 2027 admissions summary (PDF)
description: Short official-style summary in the bundled PDF. For every programme’s rules, use UWC’s programme list as well.

title: UFS undergraduate prospectus (official PDF, new tab)
description: UFS hosts this PDF on their own site. Many browsers block embedding other sites’ PDFs, so we open it in a new tab at the first page—you can scroll to your faculty. When you host a UFS PDF under Apply-Once (like Wits), we can switch this to an in-app viewer with exact page links.
